digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, ticket-model, event-schema, author guide documentation
propositions: Three authenticated file-impact states (undeclared, paths, none) are landed but incompletely documented across four reader-facing locations; the packaged author guide mentions only paths form.
FILE_IMPACT events with paths, none, or undeclared scope replace prior state and clear or set derived fields (file_impact list, no_file_impact_reason) according to explicit semantics.
Container freshness roll-up treats live none children as neutral, undeclared children as poison, closed children as excluded, and changes to file-impact state invalidate material fingerprint.

Public rebar explain plan command must communicate the three choices, set-file-impact --none command, docs-only/test-only use paths, advisory LLM no-file-impact review, and author reason requirements (why no repository files and where evidence lives).

Completion requires both green public CLI behavior test and separate auditable checklist verifying all eight GATE, three MODEL, two EVENT, and one CONSISTENCY criterion with path:line evidence at merged commit.
